name: Harbor roasted coffee
about: A coffee blend roasted in the Speicherstadt, Hamburg's historic warehouse district near the port. It is a fitting taste of the city's long trade history.
tip: Check the roasting date on the bag and buy beans that were roasted recently.

name: Lübeck Niederegger marzipan
where: Niederegger sold at Alsterhaus and its food hall
about: Marzipan is a specialty of Lübeck, a historic port town near Hamburg in northern Germany. It is a classic sweet gift from the region.
tip: Check the almond content on the label, since higher almond content usually means a richer, more authentic marzipan.
